figurative_meaning_en: A person engaged in writing or clerical profession, such as a clerk or writer
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন মসীজীবী হিসেবে সারাজীবন কাজ করেছে।
আধুনিক যুগে মসীজীবীরা কম্পিউটারের দিকে ঝুঁকছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He worked as a ink-liver, a clerk, all his life.
In the modern era, traditional ink-livers are turning towards computers.
note: This idiom reflects the traditional role of scribes and writers in Bengali society, often associated with colonial-era clerical jobs.
